## MANUAL_REVIEW

- Historical Desktop installers: all 21 packages lack a build number and none has `remoteBackedUp: true`. Hash duplicates are not sufficient proof that every package's provenance/retention needs are met.
- `%TEMP%\cetamesh-release-rc2`: clean detached worktree with an RC2 package and build cache. It is a separate Git worktree and is preserved pending owner confirmation.
- `%TEMP%\WhaleBridgeInstallerPayload-*`: diagnostic outcome markers are absent, so age and lack of a matching running process do not prove cleanup is safe.
- Other CetaMesh/WhaleBridge Temp entries and foreign installer-like packages: preserve until their owner and completion state are known.
- `%TEMP%\cetamesh-test-run-test-workspace-runtime-5a630081-7a23-4312-a96d-02bbbb590733`: marker still says `running` with PID 10152. During audit that PID mapped to `WmiPrvSE`, indicating PID reuse; preserve the 70,463-byte directory and its two junctions because the marker cannot identify a live suite owner.
- `%TEMP%\cetamesh-test-run-test-workspace-runtime-5a9b53a5-0278-45b6-8be8-18fadc44ffe9`: this 70,466-byte directory disappeared during its immediate pre-delete check and reappeared in a later inventory, indicating concurrent filesystem activity. Preserve it and its two junctions for manual review.
- Desktop `.git` garbage / packs: no `git gc`, prune, or history rewrite as part of this plan.

## PROTECTED

- All dirty/unmerged shared checkout contents and other worktrees.
- `%LOCALAPPDATA%\WhaleBridge` and `WhaleBridge-before-migrate-*` user runtime/migration data.
- Current Desktop release output, including unique or unbacked installers; Mobile and website repositories; Downloads/Desktop user files.
- npm cache: run `npm cache verify` only; never force-clean it in this task.
- Any path not listed verbatim in `SAFE_AUTO_DELETE`.

## Execution record

The cleanup command must fail closed if the exact leaf path changed, is a reparse point, or resolves outside the audited root. Re-measure the same path and Desktop checkout after deletion and record actual reclaimed bytes in `LOCAL_STORAGE_HYGIENE_REPORT.md`.

The exact Desktop cache deletion reclaimed 2,963,681,838 bytes. After fresh suite runs, seven exact stale suite sandbox roots were removed (1,908,352 bytes total) after rechecking containment, recorded PIDs, markers, sizes, and reparse counts. A further candidate disappeared at its pre-delete check and reappeared later, so it was not removed. The PID-reused workspace-runtime sandbox also remains protected for manual review.
